description: Coverage universe for AI infrastructure investment research. Positions are monitored for thesis-tracking and systematic alerting; this file is not a personal portfolio tracker.

positions.thesis: NVDA is evolving from a GPU manufacturer into the foundational infrastructure layer for the AI economy. Dominance in accelerated computing, CUDA software lock-in, the networking stack via Mellanox, and hyperscaler relationships create a moat that is extremely difficult to replicate even as competition from custom ASICs and rival accelerators intensifies. The core question is no longer whether AI demand exists, but whether NVIDIA can sustain platform-level economics while expanding into inference, enterprise AI, robotics, and sovereign AI infrastructure.
positions.valuation_method: Analyst consensus price target based on DCF and peer multiples reflecting dominant position in AI infrastructure
bear_triggers: Hyperscaler AI capex growth materially decelerates due to overbuild concerns
Custom silicon from cloud providers meaningfully reduces NVIDIA share in inference workloads
Gross margins compress below 65% from competition, export restrictions, or pricing pressure
